title: Add the `appbuilder templates` discovery command
description: Add cli/lib/templates.js exporting listTemplates(cwd) that scans templates/*/template.json, and dispatch `appbuilder templates [--json]` from the router. Default output is a human-readable list of id / name / description; --json emits the structured list (matching the status command pattern). Skips non-template entries (e.g. .gitkeep) gracefully. Test-first.
acceptance_criteria: appbuilder templates lists every templates/<id>/ with a valid manifest (cli, library, app, game) showing id, name, description.
appbuilder templates --json emits a valid structured list; both modes ignore .gitkeep and malformed entries without crashing.
A test asserts the command lists the known templates in both modes; full suite passes and doctor is green.
